On November 9, 2026, Veradermics, Incorporated (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing positive topline data from Part B of the Phase 2/3 clinical trial, Study ‘302’ evaluating VDPHL01 in males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

On November 9, 2026, the Company announced positive topline results from Part B of its randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, registration-directed Phase 2/3 clinical trial (Study ‘302’) evaluating VDPHL01, an investigational, proprietary, extended-release oral minoxidil formulation, in over 500 males with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.
